about_the_game:
HELLPRESS is a brutally challenging game about dying, trying, dying again — and testing your will to keep going until you finally beat that one level... only to discover the next is even worse.

You’ll constantly switch between four colors to avoid deadly projectiles, solve bite-sized puzzle minigames as fast as possible, and battle your own instincts while searching for the safest — or at least, least painful — path forward.

Think you’re tough? Prove it. Hardcore Mode takes every level and completely rewires it:

  • Speed is maxed out

  • Every mistake is fatal

  • No checkpoints

  • Random projectiles floating towards you

  • Each minigame is set to difficulty 4 (unique for hardcore mode)

  • Each minigame is randomized

Every level features 8 medals — 4 for Classic Mode and 4 for Hardcore — awarded for reaching precise time goals. To earn the best medal, you must complete the level without a single misstep.

Each puzzle or reaction challenge scales in difficulty based on how fast you're moving. The faster you go, the harder they become — but speed means better times, and better times mean bragging rights... and more medals.

If you're looking for a game that pushes your reflexes, resilience, and resourcefulness to the limit, HELLPRESS is ready. Are you?

Key FEATURES:

  • 50 hand-crafted levels - Each one more surprising than the last

  • Hardcore mode for every level - Think you’ve beaten it? Try again... if you dare

  • A flood of achievements - Hunt them all

  • Intense boss battles - Your nerves will crack before they do

  • Fast-paced, reaction-based gameplay - No time to blink

  • Puzzle minigames - Not everything can be solved by chaning colors

  • Global leaderboards - Compete with other players

  • Steam Workshop support - Craft your own levels

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 530 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon R7 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
